title: Edom
summary: Edom was a neighboring nation descended from Esau and often appears in Scripture as a brother people who became hostile toward Israel.
background: Obadiah rebukes Edom for pride, violence, and rejoicing over Judah’s calamity. The brother relationship deepens the seriousness of Edom’s betrayal.
teachingHelp: Use Edom texts to teach the danger of pride, revenge, and refusing mercy toward those God commands us to treat rightly.
